Canadian Institutions

Education & Training

Accredited programs at Canadian colleges, universities, and Transport Canada Approved Training Organizations (ATOs) and Flight Training Units (FTUs). Data sourced from Transport Canada and NAV Canada.

SAIT — School of Transportation
TC ATO

Aircraft Maintenance Technician (AMT), Avionics, Structures programs. CARAC-compliant diplomas recognized toward TC AME licensing.

Calgary, AB AME · Avionics · Structures 2–3 yr diploma
Mount Royal University
TC FTU

Bachelor of Aviation with Commercial Pilot stream. Integrated flight training toward Transport Canada CPL, IR, and Multi-IFR ratings.

Calgary, AB Pilot · Aviation Mgmt 4 yr degree
BCIT — School of Transportation
TC ATO

Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (AME) diploma programs — Structures, Avionics, and combined tracks. Industry practicum placements included.

Burnaby, BC AME · Avionics 2 yr diploma
NAIT — School of Transportation
TC ATO

Aircraft Maintenance Technician program aligned to Transport Canada Part IV regulations. AME licence-eligible upon graduation and experience.

Edmonton, AB AME · Structures 2 yr diploma
NAV Canada Training Institute
NAV Canada

Entry-level Air Traffic Controller (ATC) and Flight Service Specialist (FSS) training. Only pathway to TC-issued ATC licence in Canada.

Cornwall, ON ATC · FSS 12–18 mo program
Carleton University — Aerospace
University

Bachelor and Masters in Aerospace Engineering. Partnerships with NRC, the Canadian Space Agency, and Defence Research and Development Canada.

Ottawa, ON Aerospace Eng 4 yr BEng / MEng
CEGEP Édouard-Montpetit
TC FTU

AEC and DEC programs in aircraft maintenance and avionics, the largest aviation technical training CEGEP in Québec. French-language programs.

Longueuil, QC AME · Avionics · Pilot French / bilingual
Confederation College
TC ATO

Aviation Technology programs in Northern Ontario with focus on remote/bush flying, RPAS, and helicopter operations in demanding environments.

Thunder Bay, ON Pilot · RPAS · Helicopter 2 yr diploma

Funding & Bursaries

Scholarships & Financial Aid

Aviation and aerospace scholarships, bursaries, and government funding programs for Canadian students. Sources verified through Transport Canada, the Government of Canada, and national aviation associations.

Canada Student Grants — Persons with Disabilities
Gov. Canada

Up to $4,000/yr in non-repayable grants for eligible post-secondary students with permanent disabilities, including aviation programs at accredited institutions.

Federal Needs-based Annual
ATAC Aviation Scholarships
Industry

Air Transport Association of Canada awards for students in aviation programs at Canadian institutions. Available to both pilot and technician stream students.

National Merit-based Annual
99s International Women Pilots — Canada
Industry

The Ninety-Nines Canada Section awards scholarships to women pursuing pilot licences or aviation careers. Preference for students at Canadian FTUs.

Women in Aviation Pilot stream Annual
Alberta Student Aid — Study Grant
AB Province

Non-repayable provincial grants for eligible Alberta students at designated post-secondary institutions including SAIT, NAIT, and MRU aviation programs.

Alberta Needs-based Annual
